warnings.text: 061027 UTC Nov 26 1. NAVAREA I WARNINGS IN FORCE AT 061000 UTC NOV 2026: 2026 SERIES: 61, 183, 238, 240. NOTES: A. TEXTS OF NAVAREA I WARNINGS ISSUED EACH WEEK ARE PUBLISHED IN WEEKLY EDITIONS OF THE ADMIRALTY NOTICES TO MARINERS BULLETIN (ANMB). B. NAVAREA I WARNINGS LESS THAN 42 DAYS OLD (238/26 ONWARD) ARE PROMULGATED VIA ENHANCED GROUP CALL (EGC) AND/OR RELEVANT NAVTEX TRANSMITTERS. C.
